original_test_intent: Verify each installed PSU's BMC-reported name, operational status and power consumption against the approved redundant power topology and vendor semantics.
original_method: Bind host/BMC/PSU slots and feeds, query the documented read-only PowerSupply records or UI, extract per-PSU values with units/timestamps, and compare them with topology, expected status and plausible operating range.
manual_activity: An operator may need to capture PSU fields when the platform is UI-only; otherwise the read and comparison can be automated after topology and schema are supplied.
required_inputs: Documented PSU endpoint or UI path
PowerConsumption definition, units, sampling and range
safety_requirements: Associate every value to one PSU
Stop on unexpected redundancy or status fault
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw per-PSU records or UI capture
Decode status/name/power with units and timestamps
Report without changing power state or deciding verdict
engineer_actions: Supply schema, topology and expected values

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Completely inapplicable: generic sensors and TEMP_DCSCM belong to duplicate row 766 and do not establish the three PSU fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented read-only BMC PSU/PowerSupply interface or approved UI; ipmitool is supplemental only with a vendor-validated per-PSU mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Status, Name, PowerConsumption and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store raw records and a slot/feed-keyed comparison including redundancy state, power units and sample time.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic association and consumption semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; all installed PSU records remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Instantaneous power varies with workload and may not equal rated capacity.

project_override_considerations: A project must define whether absent/unpowered redundant bays are in scope and may not substitute a board-temperature sensor for PSU information.
expected_evidence: Raw PSU endpoint or UI capture
Relevant preserved events and no-mutation proof

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1489 consistently defines PSU inventory; duplicate row 766 is isolated by variant and remains a sensor case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Schema, topology and field semantics are finite package inputs; missing them requires confirmation.

review_improvement: Removes duplicate-code sensor contamination and requires per-feed PSU identity, status and consumption evidence with explicit units.
independent_technical_reasoning: The operation is read-only, but the proposed command is unrelated and the vendor schema/topology/units are unresolved. REQUIRES is therefore correct until those finite inputs are supplied.
